candidates.source_description:
Culture: Greek | Material: [Clay](https://www.getty.edu/vow/AATFullDisplay?find=clay&logic=AND&note=&english=N&prev_page=1&subjectid=300010439) | Accession No: [HCM 230](https://www.huntmuseum.com/explore/item/27a7aec1-0c2c-32a1-8449-b6a931b45c5f/?s%3DHCA+230&pos=2). | Current Location: [The Hunt Museum Limerick](https://www.huntmuseum.com). | Dimensions (cm): H 22; Diam. (at base) 5.75.

Description:
A vase or lekythos with a round base, a tall body which is wide at the shoulder and narrower at the base, a tall neck and a deep rim splaying outward. The vase has a tall strap handle ending at the shoulder. The body has geometric decoration, with leaves and grapes on a white background. This vessel would have contained oil and was a grave offering.
H 22; Diam. (at base) 5.75

Date Made: 4th century BC,Classical Greek,Archaic Greec
